results.title: The Money
results.overview: A man wakes up hungover and broke again and again, trapped in a claustrophobic cycle of addiction.

results.title: Yalanci Komsu
results.overview: Zeynep, dreaming of being the princess of her own fairytale, believes she is living a perfect life in the glittering world she entered hand in hand with Hakan, but she falls into a web of grand conspiracy and betrayal. Mine's ambitions and dangerous secrets will gradually reveal the dark truths behind this luxurious life. In this story where loyalty and revenge intertwine, the pieces will eventually fall into place, and the truth will emerge with a bitter lesson.

results.title: Drenched in Blood
results.overview: After his father's death, Gabriel leaves for Armação Beach in search of his origins. What he ends up finding is a complex plot around the mysterious figure of his grandfather, a whale skeleton and a city that wants to bury the past at any cost.

results.title: Princess Sparkles
results.overview: A sparkly pig teaches a reluctant adult how to grow up—just barely.

results.title: Chasing Millions
results.overview: The Northern Bank chain was owned by the National Australia Bank. Diana, a young Australian police detective in Belfast at the same time, seizes the opportunity to investigate the biggest crime of her career and prove herself to her misogynistic bosses back home who have passed her over for promotion. Diana is teamed with Crawford, a gruff, veteran Northern Irish police detective who does not want her help. As the case takes one more bizarre turn after another, the duo learn to grudgingly respect each other. As they almost give up hope of catching the criminals, Diana comes up with an ingenious plan which will make the stolen millions worthless.

results.title: Say Cheese
results.overview: Every snapshot unveils the essence of life's fleeting moments, a time capsule woven with laughter and love but this camera will be your last shared memory before death.

results.title: Shackled
results.overview: In a dystopian future where the parole system has been replaced with R.A.P.P. - the Recidivism Accountability Partnership Program - a white collar ex-con must take drastic measures to ensure his survival when he's paired with a sociopathic gangster with terminal cancer. One wrong move by either of them could mean the summary execution of them both, via the explosive charges surgically implanted in their hearts as a condition of their release.

results.title: Half Full
results.overview: Two estranged half-sisters come together for a road trip through the American Southwest for the funeral of their shared father.

results.title: Lo que en nosotros calla
results.overview: Carmen Castillo is internationally known for her literary and film work, in which her Chilean roots and the political and human tragedies of her native country play a central role. In this film, she breaks the silence she has maintained for 50 years around her own history and that of her children. She looks back on events that began in 1970s Chile, when her 'compañero' Miguel Enríquez—like her, a member of the left-wing guerrilla organization MIR—was killed and she herself was abducted and imprisoned by the new dictatorship.

results.title: A Good Man 3
results.overview: Ethan uses a secret dating app for married people looking for affairs. A new romantic link makes him doubt his choices while the police close in on him.

results.title: Appropriate Purposes
results.overview: Having to deal with a terrible boss, librarian Bia receives some unexpected help to put everything back in its place.

results.title: At my bedside: an autopsy of the healthcare system
results.original_title: À mon chevet : autopsie du système de santé
results.overview: What if the Quebec healthcare system became a patient like any other? Overwhelmed, exhausted, it is collapsing. Once considered a source of national pride, it must now be hospitalized to diagnose the disease that is consuming it.

results.title: Home A Loan
results.overview: A tenacious mother Eun-jin forces her family to move into a rundown apartment, hoping for a luxurious rebuild. However, she loses her sanity as her plan fails and becomes harmful to those who she vowed to protect.

results.title: Crystal Apple: Unforeseen Consequences
results.overview: Psychic spies/jazz fusion artists Angelica Apple and Crystal Floredeliza go undercover as escorts to investigate the sale of alien technology.

results.title: A Possession in Lincoln County
results.overview: A man documents his wife's cancer-until a terminal diagnosis leads him to an ancient ritual to summon the Devil and make a deal. His footage spirals into a chilling record of kidnapping, demonic rituals, and the price of desperation.

results.title: Holy Father
results.overview: A horror thriller from the makers of 'Holy Ghost'

results.title: Lo Que Puede Ser Mañana: La Invasión
results.original_title: Lo Que Puede Ser Mañana: La Invasión

results.title: 18 Youth
results.overview: Eighteen-year-old Soon-jeong dreams of escaping to Australia, but her strict homeroom teacher blocks her plans by denying her permission to miss night study for work. When mysterious classroom window break-ins trigger a school investigation, the pressure mounts. Can Soon-jeong endure it all and graduate as planned?

results.title: Ruffian
results.overview: After a viral video threatens his reputation, Baja decides to take revenge.

results.title: Rent Free
results.overview: He thought he found a place to stay rent free… but nothing in life is free.  Marcus, a smooth-talking hustler, moves in with Shay, a quiet therapist hiding a dark past. But when his plan to con her is exposed, he quickly realizes he’s not in control. Trapped inside her apartment, Marcus is forced into a twisted game where every move comes with consequences and escape may cost him everything.
